description: src/holon_coherence/ca_generator.py silently swallows OSError exceptions when syncing mitmproxy CA bundles, and src/holon_coherence/container/image.py relies on a fragile 4-level __file__ parent lookup to locate Dockerfile and repository root.
goal: Replace silent OSError suppression during CA bundle syncing in src/holon_coherence/ca_generator.py (keeping it strictly at or below 203 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) with explicit warning logging so permission or sync errors are observable. Replace the hardcoded 4-level __file__ traversal in src/holon_coherence/container/image.py (at most 200 lines) with package-aware resolution (importlib.resources or explicit upward search for pyproject.toml and Dockerfile raising a clear FileNotFoundError when missing). Add regression tests in tests/commands/test_ca.py and tests/test_build_image.py covering logged CA sync warnings and Dockerfile lookup failure/success. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Silent CA sync failures hide broken TLS trust setup, and fixed parent-directory offsets break image builds under non-editable package installations.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/ca_generator.py logs CA sync OSError failures explicitly via logging instead of silently ignoring them and stays at most 203 lines.

src/holon_coherence/container/image.py locates repository/Dockerfile paths without hardcoded fixed parent depth indexing and fails explicitly when missing, staying at most 200 lines without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
tests/commands/test_ca.py and tests/test_build_image.py verify warning logs and image context discovery with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
